scope: Main-paper integration of maximal resonance density and zero-index walls; new weak-elliptic-gluing orbit-kernel theorem.

unconditional_within_specified_setup: Maximal resonance integer chart, root nonvanishing, density for every strict order in degrees 1 to 6.
Both pointwise t-exact and non-t-exact loci are dense and nonconstructible, using the retained sorted-spectrum theorem.
Classical weak del Pezzo contraction obstruction, spherical null objects, and rational nodal cubic example.
For the standard Rains gluing of a fixed smooth rational weak del Pezzo with smooth elliptic boundary: Nq-tail=Nq=iota_q(ker Rf_*) for every q.
Persistence of zero-index spherical objects, orbit-preserving dg quotient, invisible twists, and pointed ample-model obstruction.

conditional.coherent_Phi_kernel: ker Phi=Nq requires the explicitly stated right-noetherian ring, coherent bounded Phi, finite generation of every graded Ext module, and the stated cohomology identification.

not_proved: The dg quotient is Db(qgr R) or has a specified noetherian heart.
Weak-wall coherent finite generation and boundedness without added hypotheses.
The constructed spherical objects are simple sheaves in every specified Rains heart.
Wall AS realization and its pointed comparison with weak gluing.
Local noncommutative contraction geometry, all wall intersections, and relative descent.
